name: Houkago Quest! 2
source: In a world ruled by sword and magic, and a little touch of science, at the heart of the Imperium, one of the major ruling nations, is the Imperial Academy. You recieve a spell that makes you a senior student of such academy, so you can enjoy just a little while at this world.
translation: 在一个由剑与魔法和一点点科学统治的世界里，帝国（主要统治国家之一）的核心是帝国学院。你接受了一个咒语，使你成为这个学院的高级学生，这样你就可以在这个世界享受一会儿。
